job.description:
Now hiring Warehouse Associates in Phillipsburg, NJ, with shift options available throughout the week and pay rates ranging from $17.50 to $19.50 per hour. job.title: Warehouse Shift Lead - Nights
job.description:
Our Shift Leads are energetic, decisive, and engaging while managing multiple priorities in a changing warehouse environment.

Shift Leads are responsible for all day-to-day operations taking place on their scheduled shift for our temporary workforce at our client location.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Weekly paychecks
  • Opportunity to earn OT
  • Benefits from day one - Medical, dental and vision, including Telemedicine!
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program


Pay Rate: $24/hr.

Shift; Wed-Sat 6:45am-5:15pm

Essential Functions
An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Coordinate and manage large group meetings for hourly associates, including first-day Welcome Meeting.
  • Provide performance feedback and disciplinary action, including terminations, for hourly associates.
  • Communicate and audit adherence to safety and employee relations policies, investigate complaints or deviations from policy, and make recommendations for corrective action as needed.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of confidentiality, while managing workflow for company and onsite client projects.
  • Build Relationships with Client managers through daily interaction and weekly meetings. Solicit their input of hourly associate performance and department concerns. Provide them with the guidance and support needed to ensure your partnership is contributing to their success.
  • Maintain open door policy with hourly associates, answering questions regarding policies and procedures, actively listening of concerns and issues raised, escalating issues as appropriate, and maintaining confidential conversations.

Preferred Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Bilingual in Spanish/English required
  • 3+ years supervisory experience in a warehouse environment, large group experience a plus
  • Experience in client relations, preferably in warehouse or staffing environment
  • Superior customer service, organization and time management skills
  • Advanced level Microsoft Excel and Web-based Applications/Systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate and problem solve in a fast paced, and fluid environment
  • Ability to adjust schedule for work overtime and be present during changing business needs
  • Desire to learn and develop beyond current role
  • Ability to work onsite at Client location and adjust schedule based on business needs.

Physical Requirements:

  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • Push utility cards up to 60 pounds
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  • Stand or walk your entire shift


We offer benefits after your first paycheck, weekly pay and more!

job.title: Sales Director
job.description:
Our Sales Director is strategic hunter responsible for performing all prospecting, sales and customer activities for middle market regional accounts that match Integrity’s client profile
Your focus is solely on increasing sales and profitability for regional accounts through sales calls, strategic sales methods and conducting formal presentations and submitting proposals focusing on core business offerings.

You’ll represent the entire range of services to potential customers, while leading the customer account planning cycle and ensuring customers’ needs and expectations are met and exceeded.


What you’ll do:

  • Prospects local and regional territory to develop a comprehensive target list of potential new client accounts that match Integrity client profile portfolio.
  • Calls on prospective regional account customers to understand their needs and wants; introduces potential customers to Integrity services to develop prospects into clients.
  • Manages sales process from prospecting to presentation to close to implementation and maintains client relations for at least 1 year
  • Maintains an awareness of customer requirements and needs, recommends resolution of potential and actual staffing problems and increases overall sales of services.
  • Establishes and maintains an understanding of organizational operational procedures and practices.
  • Establishes productive, professional relationships with key personnel in assigned customer accounts.
  • Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
  • Meets assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned accounts
  • Identify sales issues and make decisions quickly and effectively, as well as to clearly process information.
  • Analyze performances of all relevant accounts and monitor competitor activities and market trends to find new opportunities
  • Coordinates sales negotiations across assigned region.
  • Maintains an up-to-dates record of all sales activities and follow-up requirements within a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
  • Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.


How we measure results:

  • Achieves assigned sales quota in designated national accounts.
  • Meets assigned expectations for profitability.
  • Achieves strategic customer objectives defined by company leadership
  • Meets quarterly and yearly sales goals in (but not limited to) profitability and new account expectations


What you’ll need:

  • 5+ years of related business to business (B2B) sales experience with a proven track record of building a new book of business
  • 5+ years sales experience within a staffing organization meeting and exceeding goals
  • Willingness and ability to travel as business demands
  • Ability to proactively establish and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Ability to consultatively sell and demonstrate superb customer service skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues to create a results-driven, team oriented environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field highly preferred

job.title: Flexible RPO Specialist
job.description:
Staffing Assistant (Temporary) The FLEX position is limited hours as needed.

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a customer service-oriented individual to work in our offices and staff hiring events. In this role, you will support the hiring process by completing pre-hire paperwork and screening activities while providing customer service to the candidates visiting the office. This is a great entry-level position in a fast-paced environment that will give you insight and experience into the staffing world.

Pay Rate: $18

Job Type: This is a temporary Part time role located in Windsor, CT. The schedule will vary and is determined based on business need and when hiring events are scheduled. Availability of hours will vary week-to-week.

  • Hours ranging between 10-40/wk
  • This is an as needed position. Applicant should be flexible with hours they are willing and able to work in a week. 
Bilingual is a PLUS!

Requirements:
  • Comfortable utilizing online software, cameras, scanners, and mobile devices.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and the ability to learn other platforms.
  • Comfortable working across multiple screens and computer systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to professionally communicate, prioritizing tact and confidentiality with candidates, staff, and clients, and willingness to present to large groups.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet business demands.
  • Preferred customer service experience in retail, recruiting, hospitality industry, or other fast-paced, customer-oriented environments.
  • Must uphold a high level of integrity in handling confidential information and adhere to standard work instructions for all processes.
  • High school diploma or GED is required.
  • In-person attendance and the ability to work overtime as necessary are mandatory. This role cannot be performed remotely.

Job Description: 
  • Guide candidates through pre-hire onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth understanding of the hiring process. Deliver exceptional customer service to all applicants, fostering a sense of welcome and value throughout hiring events and community outreach activities.
  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies.
  • Ensure all client hiring procedures are fully executed and compliant with client guidelines, encompassing data entry, application review, validation of work authorization documentation, badge photo capture, drug screening administration, and other assigned duties.
  • Utilize effective communication to ensure applicants understand job details and have all questions and obstacles addressed and resolved prior to departing the recruiting office.
  • Meet critical deadlines for completing pre-hire activities within client systems, maintaining meticulous attention to detail in a high-volume and fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate effectively across various channels including in-person interactions, phone calls, emails, live chats, etc., with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and respect.


Next Steps
Apply today using the application link in this posting, and we will reach out so we can learn a little bit more about you.

job.title: Warehouse Shift Lead
job.description:
Our Shift Leads are energetic, decisive, and engaging while managing multiple priorities in a changing warehouse environment.

Shift Leads are responsible for all day-to-day operations taking place on their scheduled shift for our temporary workforce at our client location. 
 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Weekly paychecks
  • Opportunity to earn OT
  • Benefits from day one - Medical, dental and vision, including Telemedicine!
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program


Pay Rate: $24/hr. 

Shift; Wed-Sat 6:45am-5:15pm

Essential Functions
An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Coordinate and manage large group meetings for hourly associates, including first-day Welcome Meeting.
  • Provide performance feedback and disciplinary action, including terminations, for hourly associates.
  • Communicate and audit adherence to safety and employee relations policies, investigate complaints or deviations from policy, and make recommendations for corrective action as needed.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of confidentiality, while managing workflow for company and onsite client projects.
  • Build Relationships with Client managers through daily interaction and weekly meetings. Solicit their input of hourly associate performance and department concerns. Provide them with the guidance and support needed to ensure your partnership is contributing to their success.
  • Maintain open door policy with hourly associates, answering questions regarding policies and procedures, actively listening of concerns and issues raised, escalating issues as appropriate, and maintaining confidential conversations.
 

Preferred Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Bilingual in Spanish/English required
  • 3+ years supervisory experience in a warehouse environment, large group experience a plus
  • Experience in client relations, preferably in warehouse or staffing environment
  • Superior customer service, organization and time management skills
  • Advanced level Microsoft Excel and Web-based Applications/Systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate and problem solve in a fast paced, and fluid environment
  • Ability to adjust schedule for work overtime and be present during changing business needs
  • Desire to learn and develop beyond current role
  • Ability to work onsite at Client location and adjust schedule based on business needs.
 

Physical Requirements:

  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • Push utility cards up to 60 pounds
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  • Stand or walk your entire shift 

We offer benefits after your first paycheck, weekly pay and more!

job.title: Flexible Staffing Assistant (RPO Specialist)
job.description:
Flex On-Demand | Staffing Assistant (Temporary Role)

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a customer service-oriented individual to work in our offices and staff hiring events. In this role, you will support the hiring process by completing pre-hire paperwork and screening activities while providing customer service to the candidates visiting the office. This is a great entry-level position in a fast-paced environment that will give you insight and experience into the staffing world.

Seasonal Pay Rate: $17.00 - Until 12/19
Regular Pay Rate: $15.00 - Effective 12/20

Job Type: This is a temporary Full time role. The schedule will vary and is determined based on business need and when hiring events are scheduled. Availability of hours will vary week-to-week. 

Flexible Hours  - Flex On-Demand - Hours ranging between Zero to 40 hrs/week


Bilingual is a PLUS!

Requirements:
  • Comfortable utilizing online software, cameras, scanners, and mobile devices.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and the ability to learn other platforms.
  • Comfortable working across multiple screens and computer systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to professionally communicate, prioritizing tact and confidentiality with candidates, staff, and clients, and willingness to present to large groups.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet business demands.
  • Preferred customer service experience in retail, recruiting, hospitality industry, or other fast-paced, customer-oriented environments.
  • Must uphold a high level of integrity in handling confidential information and adhere to standard work instructions for all processes.
  • High school diploma or GED is required.
  • In-person attendance and the ability to work overtime as necessary are mandatory. This role cannot be performed remotely.

Job Description: 
  • Guide candidates through pre-hire onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth understanding of the hiring process. Deliver exceptional customer service to all applicants, fostering a sense of welcome and value throughout hiring events and community outreach activities.
  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies.
  • Ensure all client hiring procedures are fully executed and compliant with client guidelines, encompassing data entry, application review, validation of work authorization documentation, badge photo capture, drug screening administration, and other assigned duties.
  • Utilize effective communication to ensure applicants understand job details and have all questions and obstacles addressed and resolved prior to departing the recruiting office.
  • Meet critical deadlines for completing pre-hire activities within client systems, maintaining meticulous attention to detail in a high-volume and fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate effectively across various channels including in-person interactions, phone calls, emails, live chats, etc., with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and respect.

Apply today using the application link in this posting, and we will reach out so we can learn a bit more about you.

job.title: Bilingual HR Coordinator - Night Shift
job.description:
Bilingual HR Coordinator – Temporary Role (no end date known)

Pay rate: $22-25.00/hr.

Shift: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm OT as needed based on business need

As our new bilingual HR Coordinator, you will focus on employee relations, investigations, taking statements, documentation, and communication with remote HR leadership, while also providing day-to-day support for onsite operations.

Based full-time at the customer warehouse, you will serve as a primary point of contact for associates and client managers, balancing HR responsibilities with operational coordination to maintain a positive associate and client experience. This is not a remote position.

Candidates must be fully fluent in Spanish and English for consideration.

Shift: Mon-Fri 9am-5:30pm with OT as needed

Pay Rate: $22-25 per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the onsite HR liaison, representing Integrity Staffing and serving as the link between associates, client managers, and the remote HR leader.
  • Conduct and support employee relations investigations, including interviewing associates, taking statements, documenting incidents, and escalating findings to the remote HR leader for review.
  • Handle confidential associate concerns related to conduct, performance, policy compliance, and workplace interactions.
  • Support onboarding and orientation activities, ensuring associates understand workplace expectations, attendance policies, and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor attendance, validate absences, and maintain documentation for HR-related case tracking.
  • Assist with corrective action processes by preparing documentation, scheduling follow-ups, and ensuring consistency in handling cases.
  • Communicate regularly with the remote HR leader on escalated matters, sharing detailed documentation and recommendations.

What You’ll Need

  • Fluency in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) is required
  • 2–3 years of HR, employee relations, or operations coordination experience; warehouse or staffing environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with investigations, interviewing, and incident documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive issues simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Office Suite; ability to adapt to client-specific HR/operations systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to confidently interact with associates, client managers, and HR leadership.
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment in handling sensitive HR matters.
  • Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment with both desk-based and floor-based responsibilities.

Physical Demands
This role is based on the floor in the warehouse and requires regular walking and standing, climbing steps, and occasional lifting (up to 49 lbs.) or movement of materials.

job.title: Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento
job.description:
Ahora estamos contratando un Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento en Atlanta, GA. Este puesto ofrece variedad de turnos y paga $16.00 por hora más horas extra, con ingresos de 900 a 1000 dólares o más por semana! La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación. El puesto se enfoca en crear espacios limpios y listos para recibir a los huéspedes, y se prefiere experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles. Se anima a postularse a candidatos responsables, detallistas y que se enorgullezcan de realizar un trabajo de calidad.


Beneficios

  • Pago competitivo de $16.00 por hora /$900-$1000+ por semana. La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación.

  • Opciones de turnos consistentes y oportunidades de horas extras

  • Ambiente de trabajo de apoyo


Acerca del Puesto
Como Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento, su responsabilidad principal será mantener los estándares de limpieza en las habitaciones de los huéspedes y las áreas comunes. Usted desempeñará un papel fundamental en la creación de un ambiente acogedor e higiénico para los huéspedes, realizando tareas como tender camas, desinfectar baños, quitar el polvo de las superficies y reponer suministros. También ayudará con la limpieza de pasillos, salones de reuniones y otras áreas según sea necesario, siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos de seguridad y saneamiento.


Pago: $16.00 por hora


Horarios de Turnos Disponibles
Varios turnos disponibles, incluyendo opciones durante el día y la tarde/noche, con posibilidad de horas extras según la ocupación del hotel.


Responsabilidades Principales

  • Limpiar y preparar las habitaciones de los huéspedes de acuerdo con los estándares de calidad

  • Tender camas, cambiar la ropa de cama y organizar las habitaciones

  • Desinfectar baños y superficies de alto contacto

  • Quitar el polvo, aspirar, barrer y trapear los pisos

  • Retirar la basura y reponer los suministros

  • Inspeccionar las habitaciones terminadas para asegurarse de que estén listas para recibir a los huéspedes

  • Reportar problemas de mantenimiento o daños

  • Ayudar con la limpieza de áreas comunes y pasillos según sea necesario


Requisitos Principales

  • Se prefiere ampliamente experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles o limpieza profesional

  • Gran atención a los detalles y orgullo por la calidad del trabajo realizado

  • Capacidad para trabajar eficientemente en un ambiente de ritmo rápido

  • Asistencia confiable y puntualidad

  • Capacidad para realizar tareas físicas, incluyendo estar de pie, caminar, agacharse y levantar objetos

  • Flexibilidad de horario según las necesidades del hotel

job.title: Flexible Staffing Assistant (RPO)
job.description:
Staffing Assistant (On Demand, Temporary) 
 

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a customer service-oriented individual to work in our offices and staff hiring events. In this role, you will support the hiring process by completing pre-hire paperwork and screening activities while providing customer service to the candidates visiting the office. This is a great entry-level position in a fast-paced environment that will give you insight and experience into the staffing world.

Pay Rate: $15.00 ( $16 seasonal pay rate 9/14/2026 to 12/19/2026) returning to $15.00/hr  12/20/2026

Job Type:This is a temporary  On Demand role. The schedule will vary and is determined based on business need and when hiring events are scheduled. Availability of hours will vary week-to-week.  

  • On Demand hours vary depending on the week and time of year  

The ideal candidate should have the ability to travel to support other locations as needed; Chester and occasionally Petersburg.

Bilingual is a PLUS! 

 

Requirements:  

  • Comfortable utilizing online software, cameras, scanners, and mobile devices. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and the ability to learn other platforms. 

  • Comfortable working across multiple screens and computer systems simultaneously. 

  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment. 

  • Ability to professionally communicate, prioritizing tact and confidentiality with candidates, staff, and clients, and willingness to present to large groups. 

  • Flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet business demands. 

  • Preferred customer service experience in retail, recruiting, hospitality industry, or other fast-paced, customer-oriented environments. 

  • Must uphold a high level of integrity in handling confidential information and adhere to standard work instructions for all processes. 

  • High school diploma or GED is required. 

  • In-person attendance and the ability to work overtime as necessary are mandatory. This role cannot be performed remotely. 

 

Job Description:  

  • Guide candidates through pre-hire onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth understanding of the hiring process. Deliver exceptional customer service to all applicants, fostering a sense of welcome and value throughout hiring events and community outreach activities. 

  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies. 

  • Ensure all client hiring procedures are fully executed and compliant with client guidelines, encompassing data entry, application review, validation of work authorization documentation, badge photo capture, drug screening administration, and other assigned duties. 

  • Utilize effective communication to ensure applicants understand job details and have all questions and obstacles addressed and resolved prior to departing the recruiting office. 

  • Meet critical deadlines for completing pre-hire activities within client systems, maintaining meticulous attention to detail in a high-volume and fast-paced environment. 

  • Communicate effectively across various channels including in-person interactions, phone calls, emails, live chats, etc., with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and respect. 

 

Next Steps 

Apply today using the application link in this posting, and we will reach out so we can learn a little bit more about you.

job.title: Seasonal Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

This position is based onsite at a client’s high-volume warehouse operation and plays a critical role in supporting seasonal workforce needs. The Seasonal Onsite Operations Manager is responsible for leading the onsite staffing team, strengthening employee relations, and ensuring an exceptional level of client satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment. This individual will build strong relationships with hourly associates and client leaders while ensuring staffing processes, service expectations, and operational deliverables are completed accurately and consistently.

Pay Rate: $52-62k
Location: Phillipsburg, NJ
Nights: Mon-Fri 6:30pm-3am

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the onsite staffing team, ensuring workloads are appropriately distributed and all service commitments are completed.

  • Support high-volume seasonal hiring, onboarding, workforce ramp-ups, shift coverage, and associate retention.

  • Maintain a visible presence on the warehouse floor and build positive relationships with hourly associates and client leadership.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for associate questions, workplace concerns, attendance issues, performance matters, and employee relations needs.

  • Address associate concerns promptly, professionally, and consistently while escalating sensitive matters when appropriate.

  • Train, assess, and develop onsite staff through coaching, feedback, recognition, and positive motivation.

  • Partner with client leaders to identify staffing priorities, operational challenges, and opportunities to improve service.

  • Monitor attendance, turnover, fill rates, productivity, retention, and other key performance indicators.

  • Run reports, analyze workforce data, and prepare summaries and action plans for client meetings.

  • Communicate trends, contributing factors, risks, and recommended solutions to Integrity Staffing and client leadership.

  • Conduct daily check-ins and participate in weekly client meetings to review performance, concerns, and upcoming workforce needs.

  • Ensure staffing activities comply with company policies, client requirements, safety expectations, and applicable employment practices.

  • Adjust priorities, staffing plans, and personal work schedule to meet changing seasonal business demands.

Basic Requirements

  • At least three years experience in a warehouse leadership role 

  • Experience supporting large hourly workforces in a warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or similarly fast-paced environment is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage employee relations matters with professionalism, urgency, consistency, and discretion.

  • Strong client service and relationship-management skills.

  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management abilities.

  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and web-based workforce or reporting systems.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to analyze operational data and translate findings into practical solutions.

  • Ability to remain calm, responsive, and solutions-focused in a high-volume, fluid environment.

  • Flexibility to work varied hours and maintain an onsite presence during changing business needs, including peak periods and multiple shifts when required.

What’s in It for You?

At Integrity Staffing, you will have opportunities to grow professionally and geographically while making a direct impact on our associates’ experience and our clients’ success. From day one, you will be a valued member of the team and receive competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, generous paid time off, and opportunities for continued advancement.

If you are an energetic, people-focused leader who enjoys the pace and challenge of seasonal warehouse operations, we would like to meet you. Join us and become part of an organization committed to creating opportunity for our associates.

  • Advanced level Microsoft Excel and Web-based Applications/Systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate and problem solve in a fast paced, and fluid environment
  • Ability to adjust schedule for work overtime and be present during changing business needs
  • Desire to learn and develop beyond current role
  • Ability to work onsite at Client location and adjust schedule based on business needs.
 

Physical Requirements:

  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • Push utility cards up to 60 pounds
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)

job.description:
We’re looking for MHE Operators – Cherry Picker/Order Pickers to work with our client in Aberdeen, MD!   • Basic math skills and demonstrate an ability to match numbers.

job.title: Forklift Operators
job.description:
Now hiring Forklift Operators in Aurora, with various shift options offering pay rates of up to $21.25 per hour. Whether you're looking for a evening shift or a daytime schedule, this opportunity is perfect for those seeking stable work in a fast-paced logistics environment. No experience required - training will be provided. 


Benefits

  • Opportunity to develop essential warehouse and material handling skills
  • Stable and consistent schedule
  • Work in a dynamic team-focused environment


About the Role
As a Warehouse Associate, you'll be manually loading and unloading freight, sorting, stacking, and securing items onto pallets, assisting with basic assembly tasks, and moving inventory throughout the facility using manual or electric pallet jacks. You’ll also be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment.


Pay Rate: Up to $21.25/hour


Available Shift Times:

  • Sunday to Thursday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Sunday to Thursday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate a forklift, electric pallet jack, pacer or other machinery used for transporting or shipping goods.
  • Load, unload, pack, and unpack stock of product or pallets from incoming vehicles.
  • Transport, retrieve and/or relocate stock of product or pallets to workstations or other assigned locations within the warehouse.
  • Label and sort incoming and outgoing shipments.
  • Monitor and maintain inventory of incoming and outgoing items.
  • Inspecting equipment before and after use to ensure it's in good working order.
  • Identifying damages and reporting shortages or quality deficiencies.
  • Cleaning equipment after use and disposing of any collected scraps or waste.
  • Carefully handle and dispose of hazardous waste materials whenever necessary.
  • Adhere to health and safety regulations and company policies.
  • This role includes responsibility for ensuring products are handled, stored, and distributed in a manner that maintains their safety, quality, and legality. Team members are expected to follow all standard operating procedures, report any concerns related to product condition or integrity, support traceability through accurate record-keeping, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and product safety awareness.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in operating forklifts, stand-up/reach, order/cherry/stock picker, pallet riders (walkie/EPJ) preferred. 
  • Experience working in a warehouse environment
  • Ability to lift and move up to 75 lbs. regularly
  • Dependable transportation
  • Ability to work full-time with a flexible schedule
  • Provide own clothing (jeans, collared shirt, closed-toed shoes)
  • Enjoy working in a team and following instructions

job.title: Warehouse Yard Jockey
job.description:
Job Summary

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a safety-focused and dependable Yard Jockey to support daily warehouse and transportation operations within a private, self-contained facility yard. The Yard Jockey is responsible for the safe and efficient movement of trailers, yard equipment, and company assets between dock doors, staging areas, and assigned yard locations.

Pay and Shift: 
$26 per hour
Sun-Wed - 11am-9:30pm
Wed-Sat - 11am-9:30pm

This position operates exclusively on private facility property. There is no public roadway, highway, over-the-road, or overnight driving required.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Yard & Trailer Operations

  • Safely move trailers and company equipment throughout the facility yard as directed by Operations, Transportation, and Warehouse leadership

  • Spot trailers accurately at dock doors, staging areas, and designated yard locations

  • Pull trailers from dock doors only after confirming all required safety and release procedures have been completed

  • Stage trailers to dock doors in alignment with operational needs and dock assignments

  • Maintain constant awareness of yard traffic, pedestrians, dock activity, and equipment movement

  • Operate yard truck/yard goat/hostler/yard tractor in accordance with company safety standards

  • Follow all trailer docking and releasing procedures, including required Trailer Dock Release coordination

  • Maintain safe speeds, use horn signals as required, and stop for pedestrians or unsafe yard conditions

Equipment Inspections & Safety

  • Complete pre-shift inspections of the yard truck prior to beginning trailer moves

  • Inspect key equipment components (brakes, steering, tires, lights, mirrors, horn, backup alarm, fifth wheel, air lines, electrical connections, and fuel/charge level)

  • Perform visual trailer inspections before coupling (landing gear, tires, rear doors, trailer frame, undercarriage, and visible damage)

  • Confirm trailers are safe to move before coupling or relocating

  • Perform proper coupling/uncoupling procedures (fifth wheel lock confirmation, air line + electrical connection, landing gear operation, tug test)

  • Report unsafe equipment, trailer damage, defects, near-misses, incidents, or yard hazards immediately

  • Remove unsafe equipment from operation when required and notify the appropriate supervisor/manager

Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate clearly with Dock Clerks, Dock Supervisors, Transportation, Warehouse, and Operations teams

  • Confirm trailer number, origin, and destination prior to each move

  • Notify the appropriate team member when each move is complete

  • Escalate blocked doors, damaged trailers, unclear instructions, equipment issues, or safety concerns before proceeding

  • Use a two-way radio throughout the shift and maintain professional radio communication

  • Serve as a key liaison between Transportation and Warehouse teams to support trailer flow, dock availability, and operational priorities

Compliance & Yard Safety

  • Follow all company yard safety policies, OSHA-aligned safety practices, and site-specific procedures

  • Wear required PPE (high-visibility safety vest and safety-toe footwear)

  • Carry and monitor an active, charged radio while working in the yard

  • Yield to pedestrians at all times and maintain safe separation from people, vehicles, trailers, dock doors, and fixed structures

  • Use a ground guide when required or when visibility is obstructed

  • Stop work and notify management immediately in the event of an incident, near-miss, collision, equipment damage, or unsafe condition

What You’ll Need (Required Qualifications)

  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL A)

  • Active/current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card)

  • Prior experience operating commercial vehicles, yard trucks, yard goats, hostlers, or similar equipment

  • Ability to safely couple, move, spot, and uncouple trailers in a yard/warehouse environment

  • Ability to complete required Trailer Docking and Releasing Safety Program upon hire

  • Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification on Pacer and Electric Pallet Jack equipment (including single/double pallet jack operation)

  • Strong understanding of yard safety, trailer movement, backing procedures, dock operations, and equipment inspections

  • Ability to communicate clearly over radio and follow verbal instructions accurately

  • Must be dependable, safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced logistics environment

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Previous yard jockey/hostler/spotter/CDL driver experience, dock operations, warehouse, logistics, transportation, or trailer spotting experience

  • Completion of an accredited CDL truck driving program

  • Vocational training/coursework in logistics, transportation, heavy equipment operations, supply chain, or related field

  • Experience in fulfillment, distribution, transportation, or warehouse operations

  • Familiarity with trailer docking, trailer release procedures, dock safety, and yard management practices

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to work in an active outdoor yard and warehouse environment

  • Ability to climb in/out of yard trucks and trailers as needed

  • Ability to walk the yard, inspect equipment, connect/disconnect air lines and electrical cords, and operate landing gear

  • Ability to work in varying weather and lighting conditions (rain, heat, cold, low-light operations)

  • Ability to wear required PPE for the duration of the shift

  • Ability to remain alert and focused while operating equipment around pedestrians, dock doors, trailers, and moving vehicles

Why Work With Integrity Staffing Solutions

At Integrity Staffing Solutions, we put people first. We help associates find the right opportunity, succeed on the job, and grow their careers—backed by a team that supports you every step of the way.

Benefits

Eligible associates may have access to benefits such as:

  • Medical, dental, and vision options

  • Paid time off and holiday pay (where applicable)

  • Career advancement and training opportunities

  • Referral programs (where available)

(If you have a standard “day-one benefits” paragraph you prefer, paste it and I’ll swap it in.)

Pre-Employment / Work Authorization (Standard Evergreen Language)

  • Candidates must be able to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

  • This role may require successful completion of worksite-specific screening, which can include background check and/or drug screening based on client or site requirements.

AI-Assisted Hiring Notice (Requested)

Integrity Staffing Solutions may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as helping review application information, evaluating job-related skills, and improving recruiting efficiency. These tools are used to support—not replace—human decision-making. All final hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

job.title: Call center
job.description:
Collections Representative

Location: Newark, Delaware | 100% On-Site
Pay: $16.00 per hour
Schedule: Full-Time, Flexible Day/Evening Availability Required
Training: Paid, Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Position Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking Collections Representatives for an established financial services and accounts receivable organization in Newark, Delaware.

This is an excellent opportunity for customer service professionals interested in transitioning into the collections industry. Previous collections experience is preferred but not required. Comprehensive training is provided to help you develop the skills needed to succeed.

As a Collections Representative, you will communicate with consumers by phone, provide professional customer service, discuss account and payment matters, and work toward appropriate resolutions. Successful candidates will be comfortable having financial conversations while remaining professional, respectful, and attentive to established procedures.

What You'll Do

  • Communicate professionally with consumers regarding their accounts.

  • Provide a positive customer experience while handling potentially sensitive financial conversations.

  • Work with consumers to understand their circumstances and identify appropriate account resolutions.

  • Accurately document conversations, account information, and outcomes.

  • Follow established policies, procedures, scripts, and compliance requirements.

  • Handle inbound and outbound telephone communication professionally.

  • Meet established performance, quality, attendance, and productivity expectations.

  • Participate fully in training and ongoing coaching.

  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling consumer information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous customer service experience.

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

  • Professional and respectful telephone presence.

  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused during challenging conversations.

  • Comfortable discussing account and payment-related matters.

  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Ability to work 100% on-site in Newark, DE.

  • Ability to meet all scheduling requirements.

Preferred:

  • Previous collections or accounts receivable experience.

  • Previous call center or high-volume customer contact experience.

Collections experience is a plus, but it is not required. Candidates with a strong customer service background who are interested in making a career change are encouraged to apply.

Schedule Requirements

Candidates must be available for all required scheduling needs, including:

  • Day shift: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM

  • Evening shift: 12:00 PM-9:00 PM, at least two evenings per week

  • Saturdays: Up to every other Saturday, 8:00 AM-12:00 PM

This is an in-office position with no remote option.

Mandatory Training

The next training class begins September 2.

Training is mandatory:

Monday-Friday | 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Each training day includes a one-hour lunch and two paid 15-minute breaks. Candidates must be able to attend the complete training schedule.

Workplace Expectations

  • Dress Code: Business Casual

  • Maintain a professional approach when interacting with consumers and team members.

  • Be dependable and prepared to work assigned schedules.

  • Successfully complete required training and ongoing development.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will participate in a structured interview process. Candidates selected to interview should be prepared to:

  • Review the complete job description and scheduling requirements before interviewing.

  • Confirm reliable transportation to the Newark office for all scheduled shifts.

  • Discuss their customer service experience and interest in collections.

  • Identify Integrity Staffing Solutions as the staffing agency that referred them.

Candidates with direct collections experience may receive priority interview consideration.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

If you have customer service experience and are looking for an opportunity to develop a new skill set, this position provides a pathway into the collections and financial services industry. You'll receive the training necessary to learn the role while building valuable experience in customer communication, account resolution, and financial services.

Ready to take the next step? Apply today with Integrity Staffing Solutions to be considered for an upcoming Collections Representative training class.

job.title: Director Human Resources, Fulfillment Operations
job.description:
Senior Director of Human Resources – Fulfillment Operations

 

Location: Dallas, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Chicago or Bellevue, WA

Travel: Approximately 50%

 

Our client is seeking an experienced HR leader to build and scale the HR function across a growing, multi-state fulfillment network.

 

This highly visible role will partner with Operations leadership to transition a contingent workforce to a full-time employee model while strengthening compliance, employee relations, talent acquisition, and workforce planning.

 

 

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive HR strategy for fulfillment operations that aligns with organizational objectives, growth plans, and operational priorities.
  • Lead the strategic transition from a temporary or contingent workforce to a full-time employee model across multiple fulfillment centers.
  • Develop the policies, procedures, staffing plans, onboarding programs, compensation practices, and employee-integration processes required to support the workforce transition.
  • Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing HR team supporting geographically dispersed fulfillment centers.
  • Establish scalable HR operating procedures, service-delivery standards, reporting practices, and accountability measures.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior Operations leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, retention, productivity, and employee engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws across a complex, multi-state operating environment.
  • Develop workforce plans that support seasonal demands, facility growth, hiring forecasts, turnover reduction, and labor-cost objectives.
  • Lead high-volume talent-acquisition strategies for hourly, non-exempt, professional, and leadership positions.
  • Design and implement performance-management, succession-planning, leadership-development, and employee-retention programs.
  • Establish meaningful HR metrics and reporting related to headcount, turnover, absenteeism, time to fill, employee relations, labor costs, and compliance.
  • Champion a high-performance culture centered on accountability, operational excellence, employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain a strong on-site presence throughout the fulfillment network and travel approximately 50% to support facilities, leaders, and employees.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5+ years in HR leadership
  • HR leadership experience within multi-site fulfillment, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or warehouse operations
  • Proven experience supporting large hourly and non-exempt workforces across multiple locations
  • Experience in a heavily regulated logistics, transportation, fulfillment, manufacturing, or supply-chain organization.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling HR capabilities in a growing organization
  • Experience transitioning contingent or temporary employees to full-time roles
  • Strong knowledge of employment law, employee relations, investigations, claims management, and multi-state compliance
  • Experience supporting operations in NJ, WI, TX, GA, and CA
  • Expertise in high-volume hiring, workforce planning, retention, and HR metrics
  • Ability to travel approximately 50%
  • Must be based in or near Dallas, Atlanta, Los Angeles, or Bellevue
  • A bachelor’s degree and SPHR or SHRM-SCP certification

job.description:
Now Hiring Special Project – Packaging Associate in Macungie, PA, with multiple shift options (1st, 2nd, and 3rd shift) paying up to $18.00. This is a special project assignment (5–7 weeks) with a targeted start date of 10/09/2026, supporting pharmaceutical packaging operations where quality, accuracy, and consistency matter every day.


Benefits

  • Opportunity to gain experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment

As a Line/Packaging Associate, you’ll perform hands-on packaging and inspection tasks—placing pharmaceutical product into containers, checking quality, and supporting line operations to meet quantity and compliance requirements. job.title: Customer Support Associate - Warehouse
job.description:
Job Title: Customer Support Associate – Warehouse
Worksite: Flexport Pleasant Prairie
Location: 9091 88th Ave Pleasant Prairie Wisconsin 53158
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM (flexibility for overtime/weekends/holidays may be needed based on business demand)
Pay: $25.00
Type: Full-time

Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is hiring Customer Support Associates to support operations at Flexport’s Pleasant Prairie warehouse. This is an on-site role that blends customer support with hands-on warehouse collaboration. You’ll be the frontline advocate for service quality—resolving issues in real time, escalating when needed, and helping ensure a smooth shipment lifecycle from inbound to outbound.

What You’ll Do

Customer Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer questions and issues (phone/email/chat as needed).
  • Resolve inquiries quickly and professionally while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Follow established SOPs and document/escalate issues appropriately.
  • Adapt to new tools/technology and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Warehouse Operations Support (On-site)

  • Partner with warehouse teams to understand fulfillment workflows and support problem-solving on the floor.
  • Participate in varied warehouse functions to build working knowledge of processes.
  • Help educate associates on support systems and best practices for issue resolution.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Provide regular updates to leadership on ticket status and recurring issues.
  • Track aging support tickets and serve as an on-site escalation point.
  • Support service-level expectations (SLA) by prioritizing and closing issues efficiently.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations and partner teams.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma/GED required
  • 1+ year experience in customer service and/or operations support
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and empathy
  • Comfortable working in a team-oriented, changing environment

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 49 lbs and push carts up to 60 lbs
  • Standing/walking/squatting/reaching during shift; frequent movement throughout the warehouse
  • Non-climate-controlled warehouse environment; equipment may be operating in the area
  • Must follow safety, quality, and productivity standards

Pre-Hire / Onboarding Notes

  • Background check required prior to start
  • Drug test not required (per current job requirements)
  • Orientation required on Day 1 (CA orientation is approximately 4 hours)

Day 1 / Site Expectations (Candidate-Facing)

  • Lunch: Bring your own lunch (microwaves and vending machines available)
  • What to bring: A positive attitude; clear bags and water bottles
  • What not to bring: Weapons of any kind; personal box cutters
  • Dress code: Casual clothes and comfortable shoes (role involves constant standing/walking)
  • Arrival/parking: Park in the lot outside the main entrance; report to the shift lead or on-site leadership

Equal Opportunity

Integrity Staffing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider applicants based on job-related qualifications without regard to protected status.

AI / Automated Tools Notice (Short)

Integrity Staffing Solutions may use automated tools (including AI-enabled screening) to help review applications and match candidates to job requirements. These tools assist—not replace—recruiter review. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or screening process, let us know.

job.title: Water Utility Operations Supervisor
job.description:
Supervisor – Water Transmission & Distribution

Want to lead from the field instead of spending every day behind a desk?

We’re looking for a hands-on leader who enjoys construction, daily field activity, and solving problems as they arise. In this role, you’ll supervise water transmission and distribution crews, coordinate construction and repair projects, and help keep critical utility infrastructure operating safely and reliably.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with water distribution and construction management experience who wants meaningful leadership responsibility, room to grow, excellent benefits, and the ability to be home every night.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coordinate the daily activities of transmission and distribution field crews.
  • Plan and oversee the construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of water mains, pipelines, valves, hydrants, and service connections.
  • Spend time in the field inspecting work, resolving challenges, and ensuring projects meet safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
  • Apply creative problem-solving to leaks, breaks, outages, construction issues, and other service disruptions.
  • Coordinate priorities with operations, dispatch, engineering, customer service, contractors, and vendors.
  • Coach, train, and develop crew leaders and utility employees.
  • Support employee evaluations, performance management, and accountability.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, capital projects, and construction planning.
  • Monitor vehicles, equipment, pre-trip inspections, DOT requirements, materials, and inventory.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance, repair, project, and operational records.
  • Support emergency-response coordination and on-call field crews as needed.
  • Communicate daily work activity and project updates across departments.
 

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • At least five years of field experience installing, repairing, and maintaining water distribution systems.
  • At least three years of supervisory experience leading, training, and developing employees.
  • Construction management or project management experience strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of underground piping, utility maps, installation practices, and field safety.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to develop practical solutions in changing field conditions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills and the ability to learn company-specific systems.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • A field-focused leadership role with visible, meaningful results.
  • Challenging construction and infrastructure projects.
  • The freedom to solve problems and make an impact.
  • The opportunity to lead and develop an experienced team.
  • Career advancement and room to grow.
  • Excellent benefits.
  • Local work that allows you to be home each night.
 

Work Environment

This position combines outdoor field leadership with some office responsibilities. The work involves construction sites, heavy equipment, underground utilities, changing weather conditions, climbing, bending, and lifting. Participation in emergency response and occasional after-hours callouts is required.

job.title: Civil Engineer
job.description:
Tired of tracking billable hours and wondering where your next project is coming from?

Join our client’s internal engineering team and focus on what you do best—delivering major water and wastewater infrastructure projects. As part of an in-house service division, you’ll have the time and resources to do the work properly, without billable-hour pressure or the constant demands of consulting.

 

You’ll work on meaningful, large-scale projects throughout the Delmarva area while enjoying project stability, an excellent benefits package, and a healthier work-life balance.

If you’re a civil or environmental engineer ready to leave consulting behind - let's talk today!

 

 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborates with Senior Engineers and other staff in the design, analysis, and evaluation of engineering systems, components, and processes using applicable engineering software, calculations, modeling, and simulations.
  • Independently develops engineering design plans, specifications, reports, and technical documentation for water and wastewater projects as part of a project team.
  • Collects, processes, and analyzes data; evaluates alternative solutions; and prepares technical reports and design documents to support engineering recommendations and conclusions.
  • Prepares and maintains accurate engineering drawings, specifications, reports, calculations, and other project documentation in accordance with project requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Assists with project planning, budgets, schedules, resource forecasting, cost tracking, and project closeout activities.
  • Identifies and troubleshoots technical issues and collaborates with project teams to develop effective solutions within established project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
  • Coordinates construction project submittals, deliverables, reviews, and approvals to ensure compliance with contract requirements.
  • Coordinates with GIS and Survey departments to obtain topographic, location, boundary, record plan, and other information necessary for project planning, design, and permitting.
  • Requests, reviews, and evaluates proposals from consultants and contractors.
  • Reviews development plans submitted by outside consultants and engineers and checks engineering design calculations for compliance with company standards and specifications.
  • Researches engineering topics, regulations, technologies, and industry practices and prepares reports or presentations to communicate findings.

 

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or the ability to acquire one within 2 years required.
  • A valid driver's license with clean driving record in accordance with company and insurance standards
  • Minimum of five (5) years of professional engineering experience as a licensed Professional Engineer.
  • Proficiency with personal computers and applicable engineering software.
  • Ability to independently analyze complex engineering problems, exercise sound judgment, and develop effective technical solutions.
  • Ability to collect, interpret, and analyze technical data and reach sound conclusions in a timely manner.
  • Knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local regulations and engineering standards.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to employees, departments, consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with engineering design, construction management, project coordination, permitting, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience with GIS, surveying data, engineering modeling, and design software.
  • Experience reviewing consultant and contractor proposals, plans, specifications, and technical submittals.

¡Postúlate Hoy!
Si estás listo(a) para formar parte de nuestro equipo y comenzar a trabajar rápidamente, ¡solicita hoy mismo!

La oportunidad lo es todo.

En ISS nos apasiona conectar a personas talentosas con excelentes empresas en toda Norteamérica. Ponemos a nuestros asociados en primer lugar porque cuando ellos tienen éxito, nuestros clientes también lo tienen.

Ya sea que estés buscando desarrollar tu carrera o simplemente una nueva oportunidad laboral, estamos aquí para ayudarte. Ofrecemos miles de oportunidades de empleo en todo el país, además de beneficios diseñados para mejorar tu calidad de vida dentro y fuera del trabajo.

ISS es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Estamos comprometidos con la creación de un ambiente de trabajo inclusivo y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, origen nacional, ascendencia, ciudadanía, edad, sexo, embarazo, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, estado civil, servicio militar o condición de veterano, discapacidad, información genética o cualquier otra característica protegida por las leyes federales, estatales o locales aplicables.

job.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
job.description:
Senior IT Infrastructure Administrator

Our client is hiring a highly experienced IT Infrastructure professional to manage and support our Windows, Linux, Active Directory, virtualization, Microsoft 365, and cloud environments. This hands-on role will maintain secure, reliable systems while supporting infrastructure projects, lifecycle planning, compliance, disaster recovery, and continuous improvement.

This position is a direct placement with the client and must work on-site in Newark, DE. 
 

Key Responsibilities

• Administer Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, GPO, DNS, DHCP, identity management, and authentication services
• Manage physical, virtual, and cloud infrastructure, including VMware and Azure/AWS environments
• Support Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Intune, and Autopilot
• Maintain backups, storage, monitoring tools, patching, vulnerability remediation, and disaster recovery capabilities
• Implement infrastructure upgrades, automation, new technologies, and performance improvements
• Support infrastructure planning, budgeting, vendor management, licensing, audits, and regulatory compliance
• Participate in rotating 24/7 on-call production support
 

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• Five or more years of systems administration experience
• At least three years of experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix Hypervisor, Nutanix AHV, or Linux KVM
• Strong experience with Active Directory, Windows Server, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and email administration
• Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience
• Familiarity with Azure or AWS
• Strong troubleshooting, project management, communication, and organizational skills
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Active Directory | Windows Server | Oracle Linux | VMware | Shared Storage | Microsoft 365 | Exchange | SharePoint | Intune | Autopilot | Backup and Recovery

job.title: Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $21.75
 
Job Overview
You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team that is the first stop on the journey from the warehouse. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a sortation center. You will be sorting, scanning, and stacking packages on pallets, helping to get customer orders ready for delivery. Because most of the shifts are part-time, you are in control of your schedule choosing shifts that work best for you now and the ability to adjust your schedule in the future, as needed.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and sort inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready for delivery
  3. Use technology like scanners, computers, and handheld printers
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  3. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  4. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  5. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)

What it’s like at an Amazon Sortation Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You'll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Anytime Pay. You can instantly cash out up to 70% of your earnings immediately after your shift (for select employee groups). Learn more about Anytime Pay..
  5. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  6. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn how to use the latest Amazon technology – including handheld devices and robotics.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance

  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

job.title: Commercial Building Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary:
In this role you’ll be face-to-face ambassador of the company dealing directly with our clients.

You’ll assist the property supervisor in maintaining the physical aspects of the Indiana buildings by performing light repair and maintenance duties for both common areas of buildings and within tenant spaces; inspecting, investigating, or assessing conditions to be performed by third party vendors; inspecting, investing or assessing conditions after all work has been completed by such vendors.

This role requires a hands-on, highly skilled technician who can independently diagnose, repair, and maintain building systems while serving as the Owner Representative holding vendors accountable to Meritex standards, alongside the Senior Property Manager.
 The ideal candidate has deep experience in commercial or industrial facilities, strong troubleshooting skills across multiple trades, and the professionalism to interact with tenants, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Support basic requests by tenants for repair, maintenance and projects, utilize vendors
  • Perform maintenance tasks as directed by supervisor.
  • Maintain good tenant relations – complete or escalate support for repairs as needed
  • Partner with vendors and contractors to check in to see if projects are on track.
  • Regularly inspect HVAC, fire/life safety equipment, document results and notify supervisor and vendor of any issues.
  • Keep supervisor informed as to status of work orders and work assignments.
  • Ensure all properties are free of trash and debris.
  • Replace lights and ceiling tiles and paint when needed.
  • Communicate all building and tenant issues to supervisor.
  • Be knowledgeable and continuously promote safe work practices. Complete all required training including OSHA trainings.
  • Other duties as assigned.
 

Education/Skills/Experience/Qualities:

  • 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in an industrial commercial setting
  • Knowledge of fire systems, managing vendors, bidding projects, HVAC
  • High school diploma or equivalent (requires some technical college or applicable certifications).
  • Dependability and a valid Indiana driver’s license, good driving record, ability to travel to multiple properties and comply with company policies with vehicle usage are required.
  • Ability to multitask, remain flexible and professional.
  • Maintain a positive team attitude and provide excellent customer service.
  • Mechanical aptitude, ability to read schematics/engineering
  • Requires walking and driving to properties, bending, twisting, lifting up to 20 lbs., and climbing fixed ladders to access roofs and extension ladders
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

We are seeking a dependable and motivated Floor Lead to support daily warehouse and distribution operations within an assigned department.   • Support coverage planning, task assignments, and labor balancing within the department 

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment 

  • Step in to assist with hands-on operational work as needed 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 1 year of warehouse, production, fulfillment, or lead experience required 

  • Prior experience providing direction, coaching, or floor support to a team preferred 

  • Strong communication and organizational skills 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities 

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability 

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team 

  • Reliable attendance and strong work ethic 

  • Basic computer skills preferred 

  • Experience with warehouse systems, inventory processes, or department workflow is a plus 

Physical Requirements 

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods 

  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and movement throughout the shift 

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation 

  • Ability to work in a warehouse or distribution environment with varying temperatures

Schedule and Compensation 

Pay Rate: 24.00
Shift: Sun -Wed 7am - 5:30pm

  • Fully Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays

About the Role:

The Warehouse Associate is responsible for the picking and shipping of all customer orders from the warehouse. Additionally, this position will receive and shelve product, keep stock replenished and up to date, and maintain the neatness and organization of the warehouse to ensure the safety of all team members. Works under the general direction and guidance of the Warehouse Supervisor.

Pay Rate: Earn up to $20/hr.

Available Shift Times:
  • First Shift: Monday – Friday, 7a - 4p
  • Second shift Monday - Friday 10 a - 7p
  • Mid Shift: Monday - Friday 9a - 5p

  • Pick and ship warehouse orders.
  • Move freight and pack/box product in preparation for shipping to customers.
  • Receive and shelve product, and keeping stock replenished and up to date.
  • Maintain neatness, organization, and safety of the warehouse.
  • Verify accuracy of product labels and tags.
  • Identify, count, and sort product/inventory with a high level of urgency.
  • Assist with inventory count periodically.
  • Participate in meetings, follow guidance, and provide feedback as appropriate.
  • Adhere to all safety procedures and instructions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • 6+ months of stable work experience in a warehouse or distribution center (preferred).
  • Internal and external customer-oriented attitude, with a strong desire to go above and beyond.
  • Ability to work with others, in a group or team, with responsibility for successful outcomes.
  • Ability to walk, stand, bend, twist, climb, and perform repetitive movements for extended periods.
  • Requires using hands to handle, control, or feel objects, working in cramped workspaces and awkward positions, exposure to hazardous equipment, and distracting/uncomfortable sounds and noise levels.
  • Experience using ladders and forklifts.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis, and team lift up to 120 pounds on occasion.
  • Requires working in warehouse environment with varying temperatures.
  • Must be able to adhere to attendance policies and requirements.
  • Ability to speak/read in English.
  • Strong work ethic.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with focus on accuracy.
  • Possess strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Exemplifies integrity and treats others fairly, honestly, and respectfully.

job.title: Operadores de montacargas y equipo de almacén
job.description:
¡Estamos buscando Operadores de Equipo de Almacén para trabajar en la instalación climatizada de nuestro cliente! Gana hasta $21.00 por hora en un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, activo y agradable, colaborando con una empresa líder en comercio electrónico.

Se requiere un mínimo de 6 meses de experiencia operando equipo industrial motorizado, también conocido como PIT por sus siglas en inglés.

Beneficios y ventajas

  • Pago semanal
  • Beneficios desde el primer día, incluyendo seguro médico, dental y telemedicina
  • Programa de asistencia para empleados
  • Programa 401(k)
  • Acceso anticipado a salarios aún no pagados a través de PayActiv


Tarifa de pago: $20.00 por hora
 

Horarios de turno, según disponibilidad:

  • Varios turnos disponibles
  • La orientación será a las 9:00 a. m. el primer día


Responsabilidades principales

  • Recibir y almacenar inventario
  • Empacar y enviar pedidos de acuerdo con las especificaciones del cliente
  • Cargar cajas en camiones para su envío
  • Mantener registros de inventario precisos
  • Escanear y etiquetar artículos de inventario
  • Organizar y almacenar inventario de manera segura y eficiente
  • Identificar y resolver problemas operativos
  • Operar y dar mantenimiento básico al equipo de almacén
  • Mantener el almacén limpio y organizado
  • Seguir todos los procedimientos de seguridad
  • Reportar inmediatamente cualquier peligro o inquietud relacionada con la seguridad
  • Comunicarse de manera efectiva con otros miembros del equipo de almacén


Requisitos principales

  • Mínimo de 1 año de experiencia en un almacén o en un entorno similar
  • Capacidad para levantar hasta 50 libras
  • Capacidad para empujar carros utilitarios de hasta 60 libras
  • Capacidad para subir y bajar escaleras, cuando aplique
  • Capacidad para trabajar a una altura de hasta 40 pies en un entrepiso o mezanine, cuando aplique
  • Fuertes habilidades de organización y manejo del tiempo
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y como parte de un equipo
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y trabajar de manera segura
  • Diploma de escuela secundaria o GED
  • Debe poder leer, escribir y comunicarse en inglés
  • Debe contar con sólidas habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación
  • Debe ser confiable, tener buenas habilidades de manejo del tiempo y poder trabajar a un ritmo constante
  • Capacidad para caminar, estar de pie, agacharse y doblarse durante 8 a 10 horas durante el turno para localizar artículos de pedidos, organizar productos y completar pedidos
  • Levantamiento repetitivo y regular de 20 a 35 libras
  • Movimiento de cajas de hasta 40 libras para acceder al producto
  • Uso ocasional de un banco pequeño o escalera para alcanzar productos ubicados en estantes superiores
